alex: Quick poll — editor + lunch combo! Vote with emoji reactions or reply. Options:

1) VS Code 🧑‍💻 + Sandwich 🥪 (:one:)
2) Neovim 🧑‍💻 + Sushi 🍣 (:two:)
3) Emacs 🧑‍💻 + Salad 🥗 (:three:)
4) Other — reply with your combo

Putting this in #random because science.

poll-bot: Poll created: react with :one: :two: :three: or reply.

sam: :two: Love neovim and sushi.

maria: :one: but swap to wrap sometimes.

jon: neovim + bagel here (replying for option 2)

lee: :three: salad for the week — trying to be healthy :sweat_smile:

maria: also: do we want to make this a real team lunch choice for Friday? :calendar:

alex: good idea — if majority picks, we'll order that. I'll tally on Friday morning.

jon: +1 for bagels if that's allowed :bagel:

sam: FYI I might be remote Friday, but happy to pay if you pick my sushi :fish:

alex: noted. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
